Sara (partnerships): Quick heads-up 1 we're launching an SI immersion cohort the week of May 10. Objective: 6 SI firms, hands-on labs, private deployment capstone, and marketplace publishing readiness. Who's available for a planning sync? :spiral_calendar:
Ben (solutions): Count me in. We can allocate 2 half-day lab slots per week. Need an agenda draft and mentor assignments. :+1:
Priya (enablement): Draft agenda: week0 hardware & onboarding, week1 infra patterns & security, week2 marketplace listing & metered billing, week3 canary/rollouts + runbooks, week4 capstone + cert. Each SI paired with a mentor.
Carlos (field-eng): Strong ask: include HSM/KMS quickstart and a firewall/NAT troubleshooting runbook upfront. Those are common blockers for regulated customers.
Akshay (training): Proposed certification: "SI Deployment Specialist" with 3 modules (private deploy, marketplace ops, reliability runbooks) and a final capstone that runs an automated verification suite. Badge via LMS/SCORM.
Sara (partnerships): @Akshay what's the pass/fail bar for the verification suite?
Akshay (training): Draft pass criteria: 1) control plane talkback < 2 minutes, 2) model pin & rollback exercised, 3) 99p latency under configured SLO under lab load, 4) infra meets security checklist. All scripted for repeatability.
Ben (solutions): Can we reuse the marketplace POC lab harness? Saves a lot of time. Where does that live?
Carlos (field-eng): Internal repo: github.com/redwood-inference/si-labs (private). Harness includes traffic generator and KV cache toggles. I'll add mentors to the repo.
Priya (enablement): Cohort timeline: 4 weeks. Week0 = kit shipping + onboarding, weeks1-3 = modules + office hours, week4 = capstone & certification. Office hours twice a week + per-firm slack channels.
Sara (partnerships): Logistics q: who covers shipping/customs for lab kits? Two partners requested DDP, others are ex-works.
Ben (solutions): Partnership ops can cover DDP for tier-1 partners; others billed via partner contract. I'll confirm limits and dollar thresholds.
Priya (enablement): Also propose we build a short prompt/eval harness to track semantic accuracy and token-cost regressions during capstone runs.
Akshay (training): I'll author the eval harness. Metrics: latency, token-cost per convo, semantic accuracy on 25 curated prompts. Will integrate with certification checks.
IntegrationsBot: New cohort created: cohort-si-2026-q3. Enrollment: https://console.redwood.ai/partners/enroll/cohort-si-2026-q3 (internal).
Carlos (field-eng): We'll need a Marketplace Listing Checklist page covering metered fields, SKU mapping, test purchase flow, and legal/compliance quote lines. I'll draft and ping @Ben for review.
Sara (partnerships): Add a short joint-announcement readiness script: PR approvals, co-branded blog draft checklist, legal signoffs (SOC2 lines we can reference). We need to avoid last-minute legal delays.
Ben (solutions): Announcement gating: require signed MOU + 90-day committed engagement or explicit listing opt-in. Stops listing-only partners with no enablement.
Priya (enablement): Action items: 1) Akshay - finalize cert rubric (due 1951239000). 2) Carlos - draft marketplace checklist (due 1951237600). 3) Ben - confirm HW shipping policy (due 1951236000). 4) Sara - send partner invites & cohort schedule (EOD).
Akshay (training): Noted. I'll also wire automated badge issuance to LMS via SCORM connector.
Sara (partnerships): Hardware partner asked for a co-branded lab kit flyer. Who can create a quick mock?
Ben (solutions): I can request a one-pager from Design. @Priya want partner logos included?
Priya (enablement): Yes, but only after partner sign-off. We'll do a "powered by" line and link the marketplace listing.
Carlos (field-eng): I'll draft a 2-page "network checklist" for NAT/firewall issues to reduce day-1 troubleshooting drag.
Sara (partnerships): Great. If everyone's aligned I'll post cohort enrollment tomorrow and start outreach. :rocket:
Ben (solutions): :thumbsup: Mentors ready to help.
Priya (enablement): I'll schedule office hours and create per-firm slack channels.
Akshay (training): Uploading lab artifacts and test harness EOD tomorrow.
Sara (partnerships): Thanks team. We'll reconvene 48 hours after outreach to review firm applications and confirm mentors.
